szoveg_eredeti:
We launched the Context API yesterday and a feedback given to us by @tobi was to have decision models check for prompt injection and other forms of filtering. Basically a safe fetch for agents with scores based on custom criteria. We’ve shipped that today by integrating Perplexity Decider with our Context API.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Perplexity Developers (@perplexitydevs); megjelent: 2026-11-19T16:45:48+00:00; link: https://x.com/perplexitydevs/status/2123457725988585933; média: videó, 0 másodperc]
We've added Decider to the Context API.

Ask yes/no questions about the pages Context fetches, and Decider scores each one from 0 to 1.

Use it to check pages for prompt injection before your agent reads them.
